units.source_text: 日色过午，夕雾回到三条院本邸。

en.t: After noon, Yugiri returned to his main residence at Sanjoin.

units.source_text: 一走进门，便有一群可爱的子女迎上前来，缠绕戏耍。

en.t: As soon as he entered the gate, a group of adorable children came running to meet him, clinging to him and playing around him.

units.source_text: 云居雁躺卧在寝台的帐幕内。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was lying inside the curtains of the bed.

units.source_text: 夕雾走进去，她也不向他看。

en.t: Yugiri went in, but she would not even look toward him.

units.source_text: 夕雾知道她怀恨，觉得这也难怪，便装作绝不怪怨的样子，把她盖在身上的衣服拉开。

en.t: Yugiri knew she was resentful and thought it was no wonder, so he pretended not to blame her at all and pulled aside the robe covering her body.

units.source_text: 云居雁说：“你当这是什么地方？

en.t: Kumoi no Kari said, "What kind of place do you think this is?

units.source_text: 我早已死了！

en.t: I have been dead for a long time already!

units.source_text: 你常常说我像鬼，我索性做了鬼吧！”

en.t: You are always saying I am like a demon, so I may as well become one!"

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“你的心比鬼还可怕，但你的样子非常可爱，故我舍不得你。”

en.t: Yugiri replied, "Your heart is more frightening than a demon, but your appearance is so lovely that I cannot bear to leave you."

units.source_text: 他不假思索地说这话，云居雁生气了，说道：“像你这样相貌堂堂、风度翩翩的人，不配我来长久做伴。

en.t: He said this without thinking, and Kumoi no Kari became angry and said, "A handsome and elegant man like you does not deserve to have me as a lifelong companion.

units.source_text: 让我到随便什么地方去吧。

en.t: Let me go anywhere at all.

units.source_text: 你索性不要想起我这个人。

en.t: You should simply forget that I ever existed.

units.source_text: 和你共度了这许久无聊的岁月，我真觉得后悔呢。”

en.t: I truly regret spending so many dull years together with you."

units.source_text: 说着坐起身来，姿态异常娇媚，那红晕满颊的颜面非常可爱。

en.t: As she spoke, she sat up, looking extraordinarily charming, and her face, flushed across both cheeks, was very lovely.

units.source_text: 夕雾就同她开玩笑：“大约是因为你常像小孩一般生气，所以我已看惯，现在觉得这个鬼不可怕了。

en.t: Yugiri teased her, saying, "Perhaps because you are always getting angry like a child, I have grown used to it, and now this demon no longer seems frightening.

units.source_text: 要再添些凶相才好。”

en.t: You ought to add a fiercer expression."

units.source_text: 云居雁说：“你说什么？

en.t: Kumoi no Kari said, "What did you say?

units.source_text: 像你这种人，给我乖乖地去死吧！

en.t: A person like you should obediently go and die!

units.source_text: 我也要死了。

en.t: I am going to die too.

units.source_text: 我一见你的面就懊恼，一听到你的声音就不快。

en.t: The moment I see your face I feel vexed, and the moment I hear your voice I feel displeased.

units.source_text: 我先死了，把你留在世间，我倒不放心。”

en.t: If I died first and left you in this world, I would not feel at ease."

units.source_text: 她说时姿态越发娇艳了。

en.t: As she said this, her bearing became all the more alluring.

units.source_text: 夕雾微微一笑，答道：“如果我活着，虽然往远方去了，你见不着我面，还会从旁听到我的消息，所以你要我死。

en.t: Yugiri smiled faintly and answered, "If I remain alive, then even if I go far away and you cannot see my face, you will still hear news of me from others, and that is why you want me dead.

units.source_text: 但你这话，正是教我知道了我俩情缘的深厚。

en.t: But those words of yours have shown me precisely how deep the bond between us is.

units.source_text: 一人死了，另一人立刻跟着走上冥途——这本来是我俩的誓约呀。”

en.t: When one of us dies, the other immediately follows onto the road to the underworld; that was our vow from the beginning."

units.source_text: 他一本正经地说，又用种种好话来安慰她。

en.t: He said this with a perfectly serious face, and then comforted her with all sorts of gentle words.

units.source_text: 云居雁原是个天真烂漫、温柔敦厚的人，经夕雾巧言搪塞一番之后，心情自然平复下来。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was by nature innocent, gentle, and kindhearted, and after Yugiri had skillfully soothed her with words, her feelings naturally settled down.

units.source_text: 夕雾觉得她很可怜，但一方面又心不在焉，他想：“落叶公主虽然未必是一个自高自大、倔强成性的人，但她如果坚决不肯再嫁，定欲出家为尼，则我大失所望，太没面子了。”

en.t: Yugiri felt sorry for her, but at the same time his mind was elsewhere, and he thought, "Princess Ochiba may not necessarily be proud and stubborn by nature, but if she firmly refuses to marry again and insists on becoming a nun, I will be terribly disappointed and lose too much face."

units.source_text: 如此一想，他觉得目前不可放手，心中不胜焦躁。

en.t: Thinking this, he felt that he could not let the matter go for now, and his heart was unbearably restless.

units.source_text: 看看日色渐暮，今天又不会有回音来了，他就心挂两头，只管沉思默想。

en.t: Seeing that the day was gradually darkening and that no reply would come today either, he kept his heart tied to both sides and sank into silent thought.

units.source_text: 云居雁昨今两日一点东西也不曾吃，此刻略微吃了一些。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari had eaten nothing at all yesterday or today, but now she ate a little.
